## Checklist

- [ ] I have added exactly one JSON file inside `/apps`
- [ ] The filename matches the `slug` field (e.g. `apps/my-app.json` → `"slug": "my-app"`)
- [ ] The repository is **public** on GitHub
- [ ] The install command has been tested on a fresh bench
- [ ] A valid SPDX license identifier is set in the `license` field
- [ ] `required_apps` includes `"frappe"` (and `"erpnext"` if required)
- [ ] `categories` only uses values from the [allowed list](../CONTRIBUTING.md#categories)
- [ ] (Optional) I have added screenshots in the `media.screenshots` field
- [ ] (Optional) I have added a docs link in `links.docs`
